name: Julie Cruz
source:
A very innocent girl, she's had nothing but good things come her way in life. Most of that is thanks to her older sister Jasmin who makes sure of it. She loves her sister and knows nothing of the sacrifices that her big sister had to make. She's very kind and a little shy.

She loves to pick flowers.
She likes to sing show tunes.
